verses.original: לִשְׁלֹמֹ֨ה׀ אֱ‍ֽלֹהִ֗ים מִ֭שְׁפָּטֶיךָ לְמֶ֣לֶךְ תֵּ֑ן וְצִדְקָתְךָ֥ לְבֶן־ מֶֽלֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: liš·lō·mōh ’ĕlō·hîm miš·pā·ṭe·ḵā lə·me·leḵ tên wə·ṣiḏ·qā·ṯə·ḵā lə·ḇen- me·leḵ
verses.literal: Of Solomon Endow the king with Your justice O God and the son of the king with Your righteousness

verses.original: יָדִ֣ין עַמְּךָ֣ בְצֶ֑דֶק וַעֲנִיֶּ֥יךָ בְמִשְׁפָּֽט׃
verses.transliteration: yā·ḏîn ‘am·mə·ḵā ḇə·ṣe·ḏeq wa·‘ă·nî·ye·ḵā ḇə·miš·pāṭ
verses.literal: May he judge Your people with righteousness and Your afflicted with justice

verses.original: יִשְׂא֤וּ הָרִ֓ים שָׁ֘ל֥וֹם לָעָ֑ם וּ֝גְבָע֗וֹת בִּצְדָקָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: yiś·’ū hā·rîm šā·lō·wm lā·‘ām ū·ḡə·ḇā·‘ō·wṯ biṣ·ḏā·qāh
verses.literal: May the mountains bring peace to the people and the hills bring righteousness

verses.original: יִשְׁפֹּ֤ט׀ עֲ‍ֽנִיֵּי־ עָ֗ם י֭וֹשִׁיעַ לִבְנֵ֣י אֶבְי֑וֹן וִֽידַכֵּ֣א עוֹשֵֽׁק׃
verses.transliteration: yiš·pōṭ ‘ănî·yê- ‘ām yō·wō·šî·a‘ liḇ·nê ’eḇ·yō·wn wî·ḏak·kê ‘ō·wō·šêq
verses.literal: May he vindicate the afflicted among the people may he save the children of the needy and crush the oppressor

verses.original: יִֽירָא֥וּךָ עִם־ שָׁ֑מֶשׁ וְלִפְנֵ֥י יָ֝רֵ֗חַ דּ֣וֹר דּוֹרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: yî·rā·’ū·ḵā ‘im- šā·meš wə·lip̄·nê yā·rê·aḥ dō·wr dō·w·rîm
verses.literal: May they fear him as long as the sun shines as long as the moon remains through all generations

verses.original: יֵ֭רֵד כְּמָטָ֣ר עַל־ גֵּ֑ז כִּ֝רְבִיבִ֗ים זַרְזִ֥יף אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: yê·rêḏ kə·mā·ṭār ‘al- gêz kir·ḇî·ḇîm zar·zîp̄ ’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: May he be like rain that falls on freshly cut grass like spring showers that water the earth

verses.original: יִֽפְרַח־ בְּיָמָ֥יו צַדִּ֑יק וְרֹ֥ב שָׁ֝ל֗וֹם עַד־ בְּלִ֥י יָרֵֽחַ׃
verses.transliteration: yip̄·raḥ- bə·yā·māw ṣad·dîq wə·rōḇ šā·lôm ‘aḏ- bə·lî yā·rê·aḥ
verses.literal: May the righteous flourish in his days and prosperity abound until the moon is no more

verses.original: וְ֭יֵרְדְּ מִיָּ֣ם עַד־ יָ֑ם וּ֝מִנָּהָ֗ר עַד־ אַפְסֵי־ אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yê·rəd mî·yām ‘aḏ- yām ū·min·nā·hār ‘aḏ- ’ap̄·sê- ’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: May he rule from sea to sea and from the Euphrates to the ends of the earth

verses.original: לְ֭פָנָיו יִכְרְע֣וּ צִיִּ֑ים וְ֝אֹיְבָ֗יו עָפָ֥ר יְלַחֵֽכוּ׃
verses.transliteration: lə·p̄ā·nāw yiḵ·rə·‘ū ṣî·yîm wə·’ō·yə·ḇāw ‘ā·p̄ār yə·la·ḥê·ḵū
verses.literal: May the nomads bow before him and his enemies lick the dust

verses.original: מַלְכֵ֬י תַרְשִׁ֣ישׁ וְ֭אִיִּים מִנְחָ֣ה יָשִׁ֑יבוּ מַלְכֵ֥י שְׁבָ֥א וּ֝סְבָ֗א אֶשְׁכָּ֥ר יַקְרִֽיבוּ׃
verses.transliteration: mal·ḵê ṯar·šîš wə·’î·yîm min·ḥāh yā·šî·ḇū mal·ḵê šə·ḇā ū·sə·ḇā ’eš·kār yaq·rî·ḇū
verses.literal: May the kings of Tarshish and distant shores bring tribute may the kings of Sheba and Seba offer gifts

verses.original: וְיִשְׁתַּחֲווּ־ ל֥וֹ כָל־ מְלָכִ֑ים כָּל־ גּוֹיִ֥ם יַֽעַבְדֽוּהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yiš·ta·ḥă·wū- lōw ḵāl mə·lā·ḵîm kāl- gō·w·yim ya·‘aḇ·ḏū·hū
verses.literal: May all kings bow down to him and all nations serve him

verses.original: כִּֽי־ יַ֭צִּיל אֶבְי֣וֹן מְשַׁוֵּ֑עַ וְ֝עָנִ֗י וְֽאֵין־ עֹזֵ֥ר לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- yaṣ·ṣîl ’eḇ·yō·wn mə·šaw·wê·a‘ wə·‘ā·nî wə·’ên- ‘ō·zêr lōw
verses.literal: For he will deliver the needy who cry out and the afflicted who have no helper

verses.original: יָ֭חֹס עַל־ דַּ֣ל וְאֶבְי֑וֹן וְנַפְשׁ֖וֹת אֶבְיוֹנִ֣ים יוֹשִֽׁיעַ׃
verses.transliteration: yā·ḥōs ‘al- dal wə·’eḇ·yō·wn wə·nap̄·šō·wṯ ’eḇ·yō·w·nîm yō·wō·šî·a‘
verses.literal: He will take pity on the poor and needy and save the lives of the oppressed

verses.original: מִתּ֣וֹךְ וּ֭מֵחָמָס יִגְאַ֣ל נַפְשָׁ֑ם וְיֵיקַ֖ר דָּמָ֣ם בְּעֵינָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: mit·tō·wḵ ū·mê·ḥā·mās yiḡ·’al nap̄·šām wə·yê·qar dā·mām bə·‘ê·nāw
verses.literal: He will redeem them from oppression and violence for their blood is precious in his sight

verses.original: וִיחִ֗י וְיִתֶּן־ לוֹ֮ מִזְּהַ֪ב שְׁ֫בָ֥א וְיִתְפַּלֵּ֣ל בַּעֲד֣וֹ תָמִ֑יד כָּל־ הַ֝יּ֗וֹם יְבָרֲכֶֽנְהֽוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wî·ḥî wə·yit·ten- lōw miz·zə·haḇ šə·ḇā wə·yiṯ·pal·lêl ba·‘ă·ḏōw ṯā·mîḏ kāl- hay·yō·wm yə·ḇā·ră·ḵen·hū
verses.literal: Long may he live May gold from Sheba be given him May people ever pray for him may they bless him all day long

verses.original: יְהִ֤י פִסַּת־ בַּ֨ר׀ בָּאָרֶץ֮ בְּרֹ֪אשׁ הָ֫רִ֥ים יִרְעַ֣שׁ כַּלְּבָנ֣וֹן פִּרְי֑וֹ וְיָצִ֥יצוּ מֵ֝עִ֗יר כְּעֵ֣שֶׂב הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: yə·hî p̄is·saṯ- bar bā·’ā·reṣ bə·rōš hā·rîm yir·‘aš kal·lə·ḇā·nō·wn pir·yōw wə·yā·ṣî·ṣū mê·‘îr kə·‘ê·śeḇ hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: May there be an abundance of grain in the land may it sway atop the hills May its fruit trees flourish like the forests of Lebanon the people of its cities like the grass of the field

verses.original: יְהִ֤י שְׁמ֨וֹ לְֽעוֹלָ֗ם לִפְנֵי־ שֶׁמֶשׁ֮ יָנִין שְׁ֫מ֥וֹ וְיִתְבָּ֥רְכוּ ב֑וֹ כָּל־ גּוֹיִ֥ם יְאַשְּׁרֽוּהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: yə·hî šə·mōw lə·‘ō·w·lām lip̄·nê- še·meš yå̄·nīn šə·mōw wə·yiṯ·bā·rə·ḵū ḇōw kāl- gō·w·yim yə·’aš·šə·rū·hū
verses.literal: May his name endure forever may his name continue as long as the sun shines In him may all nations be blessed may they call him blessed

verses.original: בָּר֤וּךְ׀ יְהוָ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהִים אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל עֹשֵׂ֖ה נִפְלָא֣וֹת לְבַדּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: bā·rūḵ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl ‘ō·śêh nip̄·lā·’ō·wṯ lə·ḇad·dōw
verses.literal: Blessed be the LORD God the God of Israel who alone does marvelous deeds

verses.original: וּבָר֤וּךְ׀ שֵׁ֥ם כְּבוֹד֗וֹ לְע֫וֹלָ֥ם וְיִמָּלֵ֣א כְ֭בוֹדוֹ אֶת־ כֹּ֥ל הָאָ֗רֶץ אָ֘מֵ֥ן׀ וְאָמֵֽן׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇā·rūḵ šêm kə·ḇō·w·ḏōw lə·‘ō·w·lām wə·yim·mā·lê ḵə·ḇō·w·ḏōw ’eṯ- kōl hā·’ā·reṣ ’ā·mên wə·’ā·mên
verses.literal: And blessed be His glorious name forever may all the earth be filled with His glory Amen and amen

verses.original: כָּלּ֥וּ תְפִלּ֑וֹת דָּ֝וִ֗ד בֶּן־ יִשָֽׁי׃
verses.transliteration: kāl·lū ṯə·p̄il·lō·wṯ dā·wiḏ ben- yi·šāy
verses.literal: Thus conclude the prayers of David son of Jesse
